Source: game files.

Effects

  • [Frenzied Blade] — Increases ATK by a certain amount.
  • [Toughness] — Resists pursue-and-attack DMG once.
  • [Internal Injury] — Can be stacked up to 10 layers. Each layer reduces the owner's Stance value by 50 each turn before action; meanwhile, the owner takes 100% ATK DMG from the attacker. If the owner does not have Stance value or their Stance value percentage is less than 50%, this DMG is increased by 50%; if their Stance value percentage reaches 50% or more, additionally reduces their Stance value by 25. This DMG ignores DEF and cannot trigger Crit, Leech, or DMG Reflect effects.
